"""Independently audit every byte, strict relocation and branch of the vertex upload."""
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
from dataclasses import asdict, replace
from pathlib import Path
import capstone
from snail import match as m

ROOT = Path('/Users/banteg/dev/banteg/snail-mail')
D = Path("/private/tmp/snail-five-20260913")
manifest = m.load_function_symbol_manifest(m.DEFAULT_FUNCTION_SYMBOL_MANIFEST_PATH)
image_path = ROOT/manifest.primary_target

def audit(name, source):
    config = m.load_scratch_config(ROOT/"tools/match/scratches"/name)
    start, end = m.resolve_function_extent(manifest, config.function, config.end_va)
    target = m.load_image(image_path, manifest.image_base).function_bytes(start, end)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='snail-sweep-audit-', dir='/private/tmp') as tmp:
        directory = Path(tmp)
        (directory/'scratch.cpp').write_text(source)
        obj = m.compile_scratch(replace(config, directory=directory))
        candidate = m.extract_object_function(m.parse_coff_object(obj.read_bytes()), config.symbol or config.function, reference_manifest=m.load_default_reference_symbol_manifest())
        result = m.run_match(obj_path=obj, function_name=config.function, image_path=image_path, manifest=manifest, symbol_name=config.symbol, end_va=config.end_va)
        tl, cl = result.target_disassembly, result.candidate_disassembly
        assert len(tl) == len(cl)
        if result.body_byte_exact:
            assert all(t.offset == c.offset and t.size == c.size and t.text == c.text for t, c in zip(tl, cl))
        target_end = tl[-1].offset + tl[-1].size
        candidate_end = cl[-1].offset + cl[-1].size
        assert target_end == candidate_end
        a, b = bytearray(target[:target_end]), bytearray(candidate.data[:candidate_end])
        decoder = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_X86, capstone.CS_MODE_32)
        decoder.detail = True
        references, consumed = [], set()
        for entry in result.masked_operand_audit.entries:
            assert entry.status == 'ok'
            assert entry.target_index == entry.candidate_index
            assert entry.target_offset == entry.candidate_offset
            assert len(entry.target_references) == len(entry.candidate_references)
            t, c = tl[entry.target_index], cl[entry.candidate_index]
            ti = next(decoder.disasm(target[t.offset:t.offset+t.size], t.offset))
            ci = next(decoder.disasm(candidate.data[c.offset:c.offset+c.size], c.offset))
            for x, y in zip(entry.target_references, entry.candidate_references):
                assert x.kind == y.kind and x.operand_index == y.operand_index
                assert x.explained and y.explained
                if y.source != 'reloc':
                    # The address annotator recognizes the flag value as an image
                    # address. It is an ordinary literal TEST immediate here.
                    assert x.source == y.source == 'image'
                    assert x.value == y.value == 0x800000
                    assert t.offset == c.offset == 65 and t.size == c.size == 6
                    assert target[t.offset:t.offset+t.size] == candidate.data[c.offset:c.offset+c.size]
                    assert not any(t.offset <= off < t.offset+t.size for off in candidate.relocation_offsets)
                    references.append({'instruction': entry.target_index, 'offset': t.offset, 'size': t.size, 'literal_instruction': target[t.offset:t.offset+t.size].hex(), 'value': x.value, 'masked': False})
                    continue
                assert m._reference_status((x,), (y,), strict=True) == 'ok'
                field = 'imm' if x.kind == 'imm' else 'disp'
                off, size = getattr(ti, field+'_offset'), getattr(ti, field+'_size')
                assert size == 4 and off == getattr(ci, field+'_offset') and size == getattr(ci, field+'_size')
                absolute = c.offset + off
                assert absolute in candidate.relocation_offsets and absolute not in consumed
                consumed.add(absolute)
                a[absolute:absolute+size] = bytes(size)
                b[absolute:absolute+size] = bytes(size)
                references.append({'instruction': entry.target_index, 'offset': absolute, 'size': size, 'kind': x.kind, 'operand_index': x.operand_index, 'identity': x.key})
        assert consumed == {off for off in candidate.relocation_offsets if off < candidate_end}
        boundaries = {i.offset for i in tl}
        branches = []
        for index, (t, c) in enumerate(zip(tl, cl)):
            td, cd = m._local_branch_offsets(t), m._local_branch_offsets(c)
            assert td == cd
            if td:
                assert all(destination in boundaries for destination in td)
                assert target[t.offset:t.offset+t.size] == candidate.data[c.offset:c.offset+c.size]
                branches.append({'instruction': index, 'offset': t.offset, 'size': t.size, 'destinations': list(td), 'encoded_bytes': target[t.offset:t.offset+t.size].hex()})
        return {'source': source, 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(), 'raw_target': target.hex(), 'raw_candidate': candidate.data.hex(), 'audited_target_body': a.hex(), 'audited_candidate_body': b.hex(), 'audited_target_sha256': hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(), 'audited_candidate_sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), 'different_byte_offsets': [i for i, (x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)) if x != y], 'native_extent': [start,end], 'compared_body': [0,target_end], 'strict_positional_references': references, 'local_branches': branches, 'diagnostics': m.match_result_payload(result), 'target_instructions': [asdict(i) for i in tl], 'candidate_instructions': [asdict(i) for i in cl], 'reference_audit': asdict(result.masked_operand_audit)}
